newsitem.title: UK: GrandMet says sells Hoffmann Menu.
newsitem.headline: GrandMet says sells Hoffmann Menu.

text.p: Food and drinks group Grand Metropolitan Plc said it has sold food group Hoffmann Menu in Germany to a group of investors including members of the Hoffmann Menu management team, for 50 million stg.
"It is expected that the remaining national food businesses in Europe will be disposed of by the Spring," said the company in a statement.

GrandMet embarked on the sale of its European food businesses with the sale of Erasco foods to Campbell Soup Company in September for 134 million. At the time the company listed a number of other European businesses it planned to sell, allowing it to concentrate in Europe on its major international brands -- Pillsbury, Green Giant, Haagen-Dazs and Old El Paso.

"Pillsbury Europe will benefit going forward from lower overheads resulting from the closure of GrandMet Foods Europe office in Paris and its integration into the UK food offices in Uxbridge," said the company in its results statement.
